authority: State Council of the PRC / SAFE
title: 中华人民共和国外汇管理条例 (Foreign Exchange Administration Regulations, State Council Decree No. 532)
quote_original: 第五条 国家对经常性国际支付和转移不予限制。第十二条 经常项目外汇收支应当具有真实、合法的交易基础……第三十九条 有违反规定将境内外汇转移境外，或者以欺骗手段将境内资本转移境外等逃汇行为的……处逃汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处逃汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。第四十条 …非法套汇行为…处非法套汇金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处非法套汇金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。第四十二条 违反规定携带外汇出入境的…可以处违法金额20%以下的罚款。第四十五条 私自买卖外汇、变相买卖外汇、倒买倒卖外汇或者非法介绍买卖外汇数额较大的…处违法金额30%以下的罚款；情节严重的，处违法金额30%以上等值以下的罚款。第四十八条 …未按照规定提交有效单证或者提交的单证不真实的…对个人可以处5万元以下的罚款。第五十二条 境内个人，是指中国公民和在中华人民共和国境内连续居住满1年的外国人…
quote_en: Art. 5: the State does not restrict current international payments and transfers. Art. 12: current-account FX receipts and payments must rest on a real, lawful transaction. Art. 39 (evasion): fine up to 30% of the amount, or 30% to an equal amount if serious. Art. 40 (illegal arbitrage of FX): same scale. Art. 42 (illegal cash carrying): up to 20%. Art. 45 (private/quasi-private FX trading): up to 30%, or 30% to an equal amount if serious. Art. 48 (false documents): individuals up to CNY 50,000. Art. 52(2): a 'domestic individual' includes a foreign national continuously resident in China for one year or more.
used_for: Lawfulness of routes, statutory penalty ceilings, and the residence-based classification that decides which FX rulebook applies.
limits: Chinese text; the English rendering here is a working translation. Penalty ceilings are maxima set by statute, not predictions.

title: Administrative Rules on Individual's Foreign Exchange (PBOC Decree [2006] No. 3)
quote_original: Article 3 Full convertibility principle shall apply to individuals' foreign exchange business under the current account… Article 7 …must not evade limit administration by splitting large amount into small batches or tamper with authenticity administration by using fabricated commercial bills or vouchers. Article 9 …shall be imposed an annual limit… Article 13 A non-domestic individual can convert legitimate renminbi income obtained in China under the current account into foreign exchange and remit abroad at a bank by showing valid identity documents and relevant documents.
quote_en: Current-account individual FX is fully convertible in principle; splitting a large amount into small batches, or using fabricated bills/vouchers, is prohibited; there is an annual quota; a non-domestic individual may convert legitimate current-account RMB income and remit it abroad with ID and supporting documents.
used_for: The prohibition that makes 'quota splitting' and 'fake invoices' unlawful routes, and the legal basis for documented income conversion.
limits: English official translation on the PBOC site.

title: 个人外汇管理办法实施细则 (Huifa [2007] No. 1, amended republication 2024)
quote_original: 第二条 对个人结汇和境内个人购汇实行年度总额管理。年度总额分别为每人每年等值5万美元。…第十三条 境外个人经常项目合法人民币收入购汇及未用完的人民币兑回：(一)在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的相关证明材料（含税务凭证）办理购汇。…第十五条 境外个人经常项目外汇汇出境外…外汇储蓄账户内外汇汇出，凭本人有效身份证件办理。…第二十条 移居境外的境内个人将其取得合法移民身份前境内财产对外转移以及外国公民依法继承境内遗产的对外转移，按《个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法》等有关规定办理。…第三十条 个人提取外币现钞当日累计等值1万美元以下的，可以在银行直接办理；超过上述金额的…向银行所在地外汇局事前报备。
quote_en: Art. 2: an annual aggregate quota of USD 50,000 per person applies to an individual's FX settlement and to a domestic individual's FX purchase. Art. 13: a non-domestic individual converting legitimate current-account RMB income presents ID plus transaction documents including tax vouchers. Art. 15: a non-domestic individual remits from an FX savings account with ID. Art. 20: pre-emigration asset transfer and inheritance transfer follow the separate property-transfer measures. Art. 30: cash withdrawal up to USD 10,000 equivalent per day at the bank; above that requires prior SAFE filing.
used_for: The USD 50,000 quota's exact scope; the document set for non-domestic individuals; the cash-withdrawal ceiling; the pointer to the emigration/inheritance regime.
limits: Chinese text, working translation. Art. 39 of this instrument was repealed by Huifa [2023] No. 8; it is not relied on here.

title: 2026年外汇管理互联网信息——个人外汇（08）: 境外个人在境内工作期间取得的劳动报酬如何购汇汇出？
quote_original: 答：根据《国家外汇管理局关于印发〈经常项目外汇业务指引（2020年版）〉的通知》（汇发〔2020〕14号）第五十九条规定，“境外个人在境内取得的经常项目合法人民币收入，凭本人有效身份证件和有交易额的购汇资金来源材料（含税务凭证）在银行办理购汇”。
quote_en: Answer: under Huifa [2020] No. 14 Art. 59, a non-domestic individual's legitimate current-account RMB income obtained in China is converted at a bank on presentation of valid ID and source-of-funds materials matching the amount, including tax vouchers.
used_for: The single most on-point official statement for a foreign national's salary-type balance.
limits: A branch FAQ repeating the national rule; it does not state a USD ceiling and does not promise that any particular bank will process a particular file.

title: Circular on Further Improving and Adjusting Foreign Exchange Administration Policies under the Capital Account (Huifa [2014] No. 2), Section VI
quote_original: VI. Simplifying management of foreign exchange sales and payments of personal property transfers. (I) Foreign exchange purchases and payments for property transfers due to immigration shall be examined and approved by the local SAFE branch in the place of the immigrant's original registered permanent residence… (II) …the bank may remit the relevant funds in a lump sum or in several batches within the limit specified in the approval document. (III) The requirement that property inherited from different decedents shall be applied and remitted separately is cancelled… (IV) The notarization requirement for documents concerning property rights… is cancelled.
quote_en: Property transfers caused by immigration or inheritance are approved by the SAFE branch where the original permanent residence was registered; the bank may remit the approved amount in one lump sum or in batches; the separate-application rule for multiple decedents and several notarisation requirements were removed.
used_for: The emigration and inheritance routes, including the fact that a SAFE approval (not the bank alone) sets the ceiling.
limits: Official English translation; the underlying 个人财产对外转移售付汇管理暂行办法 was not re-read this pass, so the application document list is left unstated.

title: 房地产市场外汇管理政策问答 (Real-estate FX policy Q&A), Q18
quote_original: 18、境内分支、代表机构和境外个人转让所购商品房取得的人民币资金如何汇出？答：…经商品房所在地国家外汇管理局分支局、外汇管理部审核确认以下文件后，方可购汇汇出：（一）购汇申请书；（二）商品房转让合同；（三）房屋权属转让的完税证明文件。
quote_en: Q18: RMB proceeds from an overseas individual's sale of a purchased commercial house may be converted and remitted only after the local SAFE branch reviews the purchase-FX application, the transfer contract and the tax-clearance certificate for the property transfer.
used_for: The property-sale route and why a tax-clearance certificate is a precondition, not an optional extra.
limits: 2011 Q&A; the 2014 circular above removed some notarisation steps. Current branch practice was not tested.

title: 国家税务总局 国家外汇管理局公告2013年第40号 (Announcement No. 40 on tax recordal for outward payments)
quote_original: 一、境内机构和个人向境外单笔支付等值5万美元以上（不含等值5万美元，下同）下列外汇资金…均应向所在地主管税务机关进行税务备案：…（二）境外个人在境内的工作报酬…三、…（十三）境内个人境外留学、旅游、探亲等因私用汇…无需办理和提交《备案表》。四、境外个人办理服务贸易、收益和经常转移项下对外支付，应按照个人外汇管理的相关规定办理。
quote_en: A single outward payment of the equivalent of USD 50,000 or more for the listed service-trade, income and current-transfer items, including a foreign individual's work remuneration in China, requires tax recordal with the local tax authority; private FX use such as study, travel and family visits by domestic individuals is exempt; a non-domestic individual's outward payment follows the individual FX rules.
used_for: Why a large outward payment can require a tax recordal step, and the boundary of that requirement.
limits: Art. 1(2), 2(2), 5–8, 10 and Annex 2 were repealed by Announcement [2021] No. 19; the page carries that note. The 2021 supplementary announcement was not re-read this pass, so the current electronic procedure is left unstated.

authority: National People's Congress / State Taxation Administration
title: Individual Income Tax Law of the PRC, Article 3 (rates)
quote_original: Article 3 Individual income tax rates: (1) For comprehensive income… progressive tax rates ranging from 3 percent to 45 percent…; (2) For income from business operation… from 5 percent to 35 percent…; and (3) For income from interest, dividends or bonuses, income from leasing of assets, income from transfer of assets, and incidental income, a flat tax rate of 20 percent shall apply.
quote_en: Comprehensive income (salary, personal services, author's remuneration, royalties) is taxed at progressive 3%-45%; business income at 5%-35%; interest, dividends, asset leasing, asset transfers and incidental income at a flat 20%.
used_for: Sizing the PRC tax layer that sits underneath the balance — the part people mistake for a 'conversion tax'.
limits: Rates only. Allowances, deductions, treaty relief and actual assessment are not computed here.

title: 关于进一步防范和处置虚拟货币等相关风险的通知（银发〔2026〕42号）
quote_original: 虚拟货币相关业务活动属于非法金融活动。在境内开展法定货币与虚拟货币兑换业务、虚拟货币之间的兑换业务…一律严格禁止，坚决依法取缔。金融机构（含非银行支付机构）不得为虚拟货币相关业务活动提供账户开立、资金划转和清算结算等服务…本通知自发布之日起施行。…银发〔2021〕237号同时废止。
quote_en: Virtual-currency business activity is illegal financial activity; converting between legal tender and virtual currency inside China is strictly prohibited and will be shut down; financial institutions may not open accounts, move funds or clear for such activity. This notice took effect on issue and repealed Yinfa [2021] No. 237.
used_for: Classifying crypto/USDT OTC conversion as unlawful, with the current instrument rather than the repealed 2021 one.
limits: Chinese text, working translation. It does not itself set the fine; fines come from the FX Regulations and other statutes.

authority: SAFE and General Administration of Customs
title: 携带外币现钞出入境管理暂行办法 (Huifa [2003] No. 102)
quote_original: 出境人员携带不超过等值5000美元（含5000美元）的外币现钞出境的，无须申领《携带证》…在等值5000美元以上至10000美元（含10000美元）的，应向外汇指定银行申领《携带证》…出境人员原则上不得携带超过等值10000美元的外币现钞出境。
quote_en: Carrying up to USD 5,000 equivalent out needs no permit; USD 5,000-10,000 needs a bank-issued carrying permit; in principle more than USD 10,000 equivalent may not be carried out except in listed special cases approved by SAFE.
used_for: The hard ceiling that makes the cash route unusable for a six-figure balance.
limits: Also limits multiple same-day and short-interval trips to USD 500 and USD 1,000 respectively.

title: Money and Other Monetary Instruments
quote_original: Federal law mandates that when entering or leaving the United States you must report amounts exceeding $10,000 to U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP)… When families or groups are involved, the $10,000 threshold applies to the total amount they are carrying or sending collectively, not per individual.
quote_en: More than USD 10,000 in currency or monetary instruments brought, sent or received at one time into or out of the United States must be reported on FinCEN Form 105; the threshold applies to a family or group collectively.
used_for: The U.S. side of any cash-carry plan.
limits: Reporting is not a tax and not a prohibition; failure can lead to seizure and civil or criminal penalties.

title: Yearly average currency exchange rates
quote_original: China | Yuan | 2025: 7.129 | 2024: 7.189 | 2023: 7.075 | 2022: 6.730 | 2021: 6.452. The Internal Revenue Service has no official exchange rate. Generally, it accepts any posted exchange rate that is used consistently.
quote_en: The IRS yearly average for the Chinese yuan is 7.129 CNY per USD for 2025; the IRS has no official rate and generally accepts any consistently applied posted rate.
used_for: The §988 illustration and the reminder that a full-year average is not a transaction rate.
limits: A yearly average is not a spot rate; using it for a specific transfer is a modelling choice, labelled as such.

title: 26 U.S.C. §988 - Treatment of certain foreign currency transactions
quote_original: (a)(1)(A) …any foreign currency gain or loss attributable to a section 988 transaction shall be computed separately and treated as ordinary income or loss… (b)(1) …gain…by reason of changes in exchange rates on or after the booking date and before the payment date. (c)(1)(C)(i) In the case of any disposition of any nonfunctional currency— (I) such disposition shall be treated as a section 988 transaction, and (II) any gain or loss from such transaction shall be treated as foreign currency gain or loss.
quote_en: Exchange gain or loss on disposing of foreign currency is computed separately and taxed as ordinary income or loss, measured between the booking date and the payment date.
used_for: Explaining why converting a long-held RMB balance can itself produce U.S. taxable income even when the source income was already taxed.
limits: Statute text only. Personal basis, holding period and any §988(e) de minimis exceptions are not applied here.

title: Report of Foreign Bank and Financial Accounts (FBAR)
quote_original: A U.S. person…must file an FBAR to report: a financial interest in or signature or other authority over at least one financial account located outside the United States if the aggregate value of those foreign financial accounts exceeded $10,000 at any time during the calendar year reported… due April 15 following the calendar year reported. You're allowed an automatic extension to October 15.
quote_en: A U.S. person with a foreign financial account aggregate value above USD 10,000 at any time in the year must file FinCEN Form 114, due 15 April with an automatic extension to 15 October.
used_for: The reporting obligation that the China balance almost certainly triggers already.
limits: Whether a particular account is reportable is fact-specific; not determined here.

title: 31 CFR 1010.821 - Penalty adjustment and table
retrieved_time: eCFR states title 31 up to date as of 09 Nov 2026
quote_original: 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(B)(i) Foreign Financial Agency Transaction—Non-Willful Violation of Transaction: statutory 10,000, adjusted 16,536. 31 U.S.C. 5321(a)(5)(C)(i)(I) …Willful Violation of Transaction: statutory 100,000, adjusted 165,353.
quote_en: The inflation-adjusted maximum civil penalty for a non-willful FBAR violation is USD 16,536 and for a willful violation USD 165,353, per the current eCFR table.
used_for: Quantifying reporting-penalty exposure as a range, not a prediction.
limits: Maxima only; actual assertion depends on facts. The table is adjusted annually.

title: Comparison of Form 8938 and FBAR requirements
quote_original: Specified individuals living in the US: Unmarried individual (or married filing separately): Total value of assets was more than $50,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $75,000 at any time during the year… Specified individuals living outside the US: Unmarried individual… more than $200,000 on the last day of the tax year, or more than $300,000 at any time during the year.
quote_en: Form 8938 thresholds for an unmarried specified individual are USD 50,000 year-end / 75,000 anytime when living in the U.S., and USD 200,000 year-end / 300,000 anytime when living abroad.
used_for: Showing that the 8938 obligation, unlike the FBAR, depends on where the filer lives.
limits: Thresholds only; asset categories and valuation rules are in the form instructions.

title: Gifts from foreign person
quote_original: For gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate, you are required to report the receipt of such gifts or bequests only if the aggregate amount received… exceeds $100,000 during the taxable year… For purported gifts from foreign corporations or foreign partnerships… exceeds $20,116 for 2025, and $20,573 for 2026.
quote_en: A U.S. person must report foreign gifts or bequests from a nonresident alien or foreign estate once the aggregate exceeds USD 100,000 in the year, on Form 3520; the corporate/partnership gift threshold is USD 20,573 for 2026.
used_for: The 'family sends me money' variant, which is a gift-reporting question on top of the FX question.
limits: Reporting, not taxing; penalty rules under IRC 6039F are cross-referenced but not computed.

title: Guide to CNY transfers
quote_original: You can send money from CNY if: You're not mainland Chinese… You're working or have worked in China before… You have a valid tax record issued by the China tax authority showing taxes paid within the last 3 years… If you're sending CNY from your China bank app, the maximum you can send in one transfer is 300,000 CNY… your overall limit is the amount of salary you've earned in China after deducting the amount of tax paid in China.
quote_en: Wise will only send from CNY for a non-mainland-Chinese customer who worked in China and can show a China tax record of taxes paid within the last three years; the single-transfer cap through a China bank app is CNY 300,000, and the total limit is salary earned minus tax paid.
used_for: Pricing the practical eligibility of the Wise route and its published caps.
limits: Wise publishes no CNY fee table ('set up a transfer… to see the exact fees'), so no fee or all-in figure is stated here. Provider documentation describes Wise only.
